output.summary: KEP-2330 proposes a vendor-agnostic tool to migrate stored Kubernetes API objects to the latest storage version, covering built-in APIs, custom resources, and aggregated APIs. Its status is implementable at alpha stage, with implementable status dated 2021-02-09.
output.rationale: Objects created in one Kubernetes version can remain in an old stored version through upgrades until a later version cannot interpret them. The KEP proposes a migration tool that rewrites stored objects, with goals including low apiserver load, progress under flaky conditions, and progress tracking. The sources show only an approval comment on the revised PR; they do not record detailed reasoning for the implementable decision.

alternatives.option: Reuse the existing oc adm migrate storage command as-is
alternatives.why_not: The sources say the tool 'extends and improves based on the oc adm migrate storage command', so the KEP builds on it rather than adopting it unchanged; no further reasoning is given.

evidence.quote: We propose a solution to migrate the stored API objects in Kubernetes clusters. In 2018 Q4, we will deliver a tool of alpha quality.
Today it is possible to create API objects (e.g., HPAs) in one version of Kubernetes, go through multiple upgrade cycles without touching those objects
We will deliver a vendor-agnostic solution to automatically detect and migrate resources when the default storage version has changed.
Since you approved the original one, I will simply lgtm this one :) /lgtm
